async function repeated(items) {
	for (let i = 0, n = items.length, last = n - 1; i < n; i++) {
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		await save(items[i]);
	}
	let i = 0;
	for (; i < items.length; i++) {
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		await save(items[i]);
	}
	for (let i = items.length; i-- > 0; ) {
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		await save(items[i]);
	}
	for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) if (await ready(i)) return i;
	for (const item of items) if (await ready(item)) break;
	for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) await sleep(100);
	for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
		const helper = () => {
			return true;
		};
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		await save(items[i]);
	}
	for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++)
		if (items[i]) {
			// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
			await save(items[i]);
		}
}
